title: Migrate App.config/Web.config settings to appsettings.json
description: Extracts <appSettings>/<connectionStrings> entries from a legacy App.config or Web.config and writes the equivalent appsettings.json structure, for use with .NET Core's Options pattern. Do NOT remove or empty the original config file(s) without producing this replacement in the same edit -- the config file(s) being present in the declared scope is so their settings can be read and ported, not so they can be deleted. If you cannot determine what belongs in appsettings.json, leave the original file(s) untouched rather than deleting them.

parameters.name: config_path
parameters.description: Path to the App.config or Web.config file to read from.

parameters.name: output_path
parameters.description: Path to write appsettings.json to (defaults to alongside the project file).

notes: If the config file contains a connection string with an embedded credential, DISCLOSE-1/SECRET-1 already forbid a phase from sending it to a model provider or including it in scope silently -- this template does not change that; a phase touching such a file still halts per DISCLOSE-1's rule, not per this template. expected_new_paths is what Phase F's first real run was missing: without a check that this file actually gets created, a phase that deletes the originals and produces nothing is indistinguishable from success.
